identificationModule.briefTitle: Icotinib Combined With WBRT For NSCLC Patients With Brain Metastases and EGFR Mutation
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single Center, Open Label, Dose-Finding Study to Determine the Safety of Icotinib in Combination With Whole Brain Radiation Therapy For NSCLC Patients With Brain Metastases and EGFR Mutation.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of Icotinib at different dose levels in combination with whole brain radiotherapy for NSCLC patients with brain metastases and EGFR mutation.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The long-term control of brain metastases becomes a clinical challenge. Whole brain radiotherapy, the standard treatment for patients with multiple brain metastases, can only bring a modest survival improvement around 3-6 months. EGFR-TKIs like icotinib with its proven activity in non-small cell lung cancer may provide clinical benefits in such patients.

armGroups.label: Icotinib+WBRT
armGroups.description: Standard whole brain radiotherapy plus icotinib, which is designed to administered at 5 dose according to "3+3" until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

interventions.name: icotinib
interventions.description:
Level 1: Standard whole brain radiation therapy plus icotinib 125 mg Tid (375 mg per day) from day1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

Level 2: Standard whole brain radiation therapy plus icotinib 250 mg Tid (750 mg per day) from day1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

Level 3: Standard whole brain radiation therapy plus icotinib 375 mg Tid (1125 mg per day) from day1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

Level 4:Standard whole brain radiation therapy plus icotinib 500 mg Tid (1500 mg per day) from day1 until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

interventions.name: Whole brain radiotherapy
interventions.description: Whole Brain Radiation Therapy (WBRT) for total dose of 37.5Gy in 15 daily fractions beginning after Day 7.

primaryOutcomes.description: All cause adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs)

secondaryOutcomes.description: All cause neurological progress or mortality

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quality of life measured by FACT-L/LCS 4.0

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluated according to Mini-Mental Status Examination

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histological or cytological confirmation of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
* Diagnosis of brain metastases on a Gadolinium-enhanced MRI. More than 3 sites of intracranial metastases, or the longest diameter of the intracranial lesion is more than 3cm.
* Positive EGFR mutation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous usage of EGFR-TKI or antibody to EGFR: gefitinib, erlotinib, herceptin, erbitux.
* CSF or MRI findings consistent with metastases of spinal cord, meninges or meningeal.
